title: boea hygroscopica var. typica

This plant is known for its ability to absorb and store water, and it has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of Boea hygroscopica var. typica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
